items.movement: As you work through these first couple of weeks of Raw Strength, you’ll notice that the RPE feels pretty light and easy. This is intentional and designed to ramp you up for bigger lifts and increased difficulty in the later weeks of the course.
Things will become more challenging soon, so stay focused, ensure you’re lifting with good technique, and take this opportunity to dial in your RPE.
Build to a 1 in 5-7 mins @ RPE 5-6
Followed by
3x5 @ 75% of prior weight
Rest at least 2 minutes between sets
Build to a set of 7 in 5-7 mins @ RPE 5-6
Followed by
3x10 @ 75% of prior weight
Rest at least 2 minutes between sets
Build to 3x10-12 @ RPE 6-7
Rest at least 2 minutes between sets
3 sets x 30 seconds
